methodologyNotes: Covers aftermarket truck bed tonneau covers sold at a published US price, across the soft-fold, hard-fold, soft-roll-up, hard-roll-up, retractable, and one-piece-hinged families. Excludes OEM factory-installed covers, bed caps/toppers, and camper shells. Because each model ships in many truck-specific fitments, dimensional and weight figures are for a representative full-size short bed (~5.5-6.5 ft) application, and price is typical US MSRP in USD for that fitment (varies by truck). coverType is an enum: soft-fold, hard-fold, soft-roll-up, hard-roll-up, retractable, or one-piece-hinged. material is the primary cover-surface material enum: vinyl, aluminum, frp (fiberglass-reinforced polymer), abs-polymer, or tpo. weightCapacityLbs is the manufacturer's evenly-distributed static load rating in pounds; null if not published. bedAccessPercent is the share of bed length left open when the cover is fully folded, rolled, or retracted, expressed as a percent. lockable is true if the cover has integrated locking or latches secured by the closed tailgate as sold. weatherSeal is the published sealing class: weather-resistant or weathertight. lowProfileHeightIn is how far the closed cover sits above the bed rails, in inches. coverWeightLbs is the assembled cover weight in pounds for the representative fitment. installType is an enum: clamp-on (no-drill) or drill-required. warrantyTerm is the manufacturer's warranty as sold, e.g. 3-year, 5-year, or lifetime.

products.name: BAKFlip MX4
products.priceNote: Retailer TruckBedSupplies lists the BAKFlip MX4 (GEN 3) at "$1,199.99" (free shipping), and RealTruck (BAK's manufacturer store) lists it "From: $1,199.99". The official BAKFlip site lists $1,149 for full-size short beds (F-150 5'7", Silverado 5'10") and $1,199 for other/longer fitments — price varies by truck. Using $1,199.99 as the typical US price for the representative full-size short-bed fitment.
products.provenance: The official BAKFlip product page (bakflipstore.com/bakflip-mx4/) confirms this is the third-generation (GEN 3) BAKFlip MX4 hard-folding aluminum cover and states verbatim: 400 lbs evenly distributed capacity, 100% full bed access, auto-latching at the closed tailgate, no-drill install, a 5-Year warranty, and an assembled weight of 71 lbs for the representative full-size short beds (Ford F-150 5'7" and Chevy/GMC Silverado/Sierra 5'10"), priced $1,149–$1,199 depending on fitment. The TruckBedSupplies retailer page (SKU "BAKFlip MX4", titled "BAKFlip MX4 (GEN 3) Hard Folding Tonneau Cover") corroborates the same specs — "400 lbs. weight capacity (evenly distributed)", "100% bed access", Material: Aluminum, "5-year warranty", clamp-on/no-drill install — and lists the price at "$1,199.99", matching RealTruck's "From: $1,199.99". Both pages explicitly identify the GEN 3 MX4 and distinguish it from the G2, F1, FiberMax, and MX4 TS variants, confirming exact-model identity; weatherSeal is set to weather-resistant since the retailer FAQ states "no tonneau cover is 100% waterproof" (EPDM seals plus drain tubes = water-resistant, not weathertight), and lowProfileHeightIn is null as no numeric rail-height inch value is published.

products.name: RetraxPRO XR

products.name: TruXedo Sentry CT
products.priceNote: Total Off Road (authorized TruXedo dealer, corroboration URL) lists the Sentry CT at "$1,099.99 - $1,349.99" across truck fitments. The $1,099.99 low end is used here as the typical US price for a representative full-size short bed; the higher figure is for longer/wider beds. products.provenance: The TruXedo/RealTruck manufacturer product page (source URL) returned no readable content to the fetcher, so all values were extracted verbatim from Total Off Road (corroboration), an authorized dealer that reproduces TruXedo's official product copy: it confirms this exact model as the "Sentry CT" hard roll-up with heavy-duty black aluminum slats pressure-bonded to matte-black woven fabric, no-drill/tool-free install, slam + center security latches, and a "Warranty: 5 Years", and lists it at "$1,099.99 - $1,349.99". Model identity was cross-checked against a dated Dec 2025 review (Muddy Ruttzz) that explicitly distinguishes the Sentry CT (5-year warranty, canvas fabric) from the base Sentry (3-year, vinyl), plus Mid-West Truck Accessories and Rack Warehouse dealer pages, all agreeing on aluminum-slat construction, no-drill install, and the 5-year warranty. Weight capacity, bed-access percent, weather-seal class, low-profile height, and cover weight were left null because no fetched page stated them for the CT specifically (the "400 lb" figure appears only in the base-Sentry portion of the review and in unfetched search text, not verbatim on any fetched CT page).
